dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (JMA standard receipt software), likely compiled with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL on Linux. Uses COPY copybooks COMMON-SPA and CPORCSC96.INC, LINKAGE SECTION with SPA-AREA pattern typical of ORCA subsystem components.

purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical insurance claim (receipt/rezept) processing system - ORCA (JMA standard receipt software). This component handles error message setting for medical treatment act input (診療行為入力).
purpose.summary: ORCSC96 is an error message composition subprogram within the JMA ORCA medical receipt system. It receives an error code via the SPA shared parameter area and maps it to a Japanese-language error message string, covering common errors (K0xx, 00xx codes) related to medical treatment act input as well as program-specific messages. It is called as a subprogram and exits via EXIT PROGRAM.

notable_features: LINKAGE SECTION with SPA-AREA and ORCSC96AREA parameters
Large EVALUATE/WHEN block mapping error codes to Japanese EUC-encoded messages
STRING...DELIMITED BY SIZE for multi-part messages
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
Japanese EUC encoding in comment and literal strings (latin-1 decoded)
verdict.notes: Source is encoded in EUC-JP (Japanese) but decoded as latin-1, causing mojibake in comments and string literals. The program is part of the well-known open-source JMA ORCA medical receipt system. File truncated at 16000 chars out of 113569 bytes (2380 lines total); the visible portion covers the common error message section (100-KYOUTU-ERRMSG-SEC) with many WHEN clauses; the program-specific section (200-PG-ERRMSG-SEC) is not shown but referenced.
